contexts.text: I saw two swans flying towards the north... The two swans bent their course from the north to the east... I saw the swans fly into the palace, through the open windows in the lowest row... The lowest part of the palace, into which the swans betook themselves, represented the lowest region of the mind, where dwells conjugial love in the love of what is just and right with their knowledge... The pair of swans also = the conjugial love of the lowest region.

There are others who are consociated around a great swan, or a swan with a neck stretched up to a great height, and who follow it. Such a phantasy reigns with those who in the life of the body seem to themselves learned.
